fusions.name: Shake Dry
fusions.desc: Shakes yourself dry, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles with a 50% chance to leave each [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Casual Afterthought
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy within 3 tiles for 18 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach. It uses up every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each.

fusions.name: Disdainful Shrug
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each affliction put on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever cast it.

fusions.name: Unruffled Luck
fusions.desc: A dodge that fails is rolled again. Once every 10 seconds.
